value.rationale: A natural globally defined cycle-size statistic and the complete local indegree histogram of a functional digraph have sharply class-dependent covariance signs. The indegree-two unique crossover is a natural finite-size and asymptotic cutoff, not an ad hoc parameter or just an improved decimal; the convex-score theorem provides a structural explanation organizing all occupancy scores. Earlier indegree-zero covariance is acknowledged, not repackaged as novelty. Applications involving long cycles are limited by event rarity, which is explicitly stated.
